connector.name: Slack Lists MCP
connector.registryDescription: Full read + write access to Slack Lists for AI: create, update, check off, reassign, delete.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package ars-slack-lists-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the justadityaraj account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-...) for an app with lists:read and lists:write scopes. The bot must be given access to each List it manages.
